Author: Rayla Petal
Name: Cummy
Description:
Pair with someone over tells, then right-click them to layer cum onto a body part. Layers stack on top of their own current skin (Bibo body), are published through Penumbra so sync plugins show them to everyone, and stay until cleaned or dried off.
Requires Penumbra. 18+ content.
Punchline: Cum layering system for your paired partners.
Changelog:
- Layers, licks, creampies, pairing and unpairing with Cummy users you're synced with (Lightless, Mare...) now travel through a small SimpleHeels tag instead of hidden tells, so they no longer show up in tell windows or change your /r target. Anyone on an older Cummy or not synced still gets tells.
- New setting "Send through sync instead of tells" (Settings > Other plugins), on by default.
- Testing builds can now be opted into from the plugin installer.
